{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABeiukiA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhIDwWc", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 318, "title": "Remove Chrome extension Options menu entry (keep Models accessible in-app)", "body": "## Goal

Remove the Chrome-provided **Options** entry from the extension icon's right-click menu for now. Currently selecting **Options** opens the **Models** page, which is a model-management screen rather than general extension settings.

Do **not** remove the Models page or its existing in-app navigation: only stop advertising it as Chrome's extension **Options** page.

## Current implementation

[`extension/manifest.json`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/manifest.json) declares:

```json
"options_ui": { "page": "extension/model-cache.html", "open_in_tab": true }
```

Chrome generates the **Options** context-menu entry from this manifest property. This is not an item implemented by the extension's own `chrome.contextMenus` API.

## Required change

1. Remove the entire `options_ui` property from `extension/manifest.json`; ensure the manifest remains syntactically valid.
2. Do **not** substitute `options_page`, another `options_ui` declaration, or a custom **Options** context-menu item.
3. Preserve `extension/model-cache.html`, its scripts/styles, and all model preparation/cache-management functionality.
4. Preserve existing in-app links/navigation to the Models screen (Graph Library, Graph Editor, etc.). These should still open Models normally.
5. If any documentation/tests state that users reach Models using extension icon → Options, update them to point to the existing Models navigation; avoid unnecessary edits elsewhere.
6. Do not change Chrome's other built-in extension menu entries, unrelated custom menu entries (e.g. Graphs), or extension permissions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] With the updated extension reloaded in Chrome, right-clicking the toolbar extension icon no longer offers **Options** (subject to browser-supplied UI); no replacement custom Options item is introduced.
- [ ] The manifest has neither `options_ui` nor `options_page`.
- [ ] The Models page continues to work when opened through existing in-app navigation and retains all features.
- [ ] Existing Graph Library, Graph Editor, toolbar menu, model management, and execution flows remain unaffected.
- [ ] Manifest validation and relevant automated smoke/UI tests pass.

## Scope note

This is intentionally a temporary UI simplification. If the extension gains a true global settings screen later, consider registering an Options page then. Do not build such a settings screen in this task.
